_comment: Which regression run specs belong to each release type. Each profile lists every spec it runs in full — there is no inheritance, so the list is exactly what gets passed to the run-creation script. 'full' is NOT a superset of 'partial': Directory Connector (BWDC) runs on partial releases only, and CLI, Desktop, and Extension on full releases only. Spec names are file names in specs/ without the .json extension.
